notes.title: Patchnotes - Patch 1.2.5
notes.content:
Major features:

- Taunt: Character which have a shield equipped can now taunt groups of enemies, forcing them to attack said character. This option is only availble for characters which have a shield equipped and replaces the Defend option. Taunt is not a a priority action like Defend, so the initiative boost does not apply to Taunt.
- Loot All Distribute: A new quality of life feature, that automatically distributes loot to characters which can most use it. You can also press Ctrl+Left Click on an object you want to loot. This includes:
[list]
[*]    Crafting Materials will go to characters with the appropriate professions.
[*]    Food and Drinks gets distributed relatively evenly accross all party members. 
[*]    Spell scrolls go to a character who invested points in that particular school of magic.
[*]    Weapons go to Characters which have points invested in that particular weapon category.
[/list]

Minor changes:
- Rebalanced a lot of early game enemies. This was mainly to remove some sudden difficulty spikes / bad luck protection.
- We made a lot of the defensive spells less spamable and as a result of that also lowered attack values of a large set of enemies.
- A lot of item balance changes.
- A lot Bug fixes (If you encounter any bugs, please report them in the steam forums)

notes.title: New Patch and Free to Play
notes.content:
It's been a while, but we're excited to finally announce a new patch. The patch is not yet stable, so if you experience some bugs, please take the time to report them on our official [url=http://www.equilibriumofdivinity.com/]website[/url] or in the Steam discussion boards.

Players who own the game on Steam can rightclick the game in their Steam library, goto properties and change to the beta branch in their BETA settings to access the new patch.

New players can download the full game from our website in the [url=http://www.equilibriumofdivinity.com/download/]Download Section[/url].

Please note that because the game uses Steams leaderboard function, only player who own the game on Steam and are logged into their Steam account will be able to post their highscores to the leaderboards.

Patch notes 1.1.2:

- Elite Monsters now spawn in Hard & Ultra Hard difficulties. Those monsters offer an extra challenge but can provide valuable rare drops.
- Added Wishing Well Landmark: This gives you more agency about the items you'll find in future dungeons. But wishes are never free.
- Added Altar of Magic Conversion Landmark: This lets you convert some magical items that you don't need to add permanent resistances to your characters.
- Agility breakpoints are added, which will affect your Spell Damage depending on your equip burden. There is more planned for this feature in the future.
- Added Filter Options for Gemcrafters the Crafting Menu.
- No more software mouse cursors (Should eliminate mouse lag)
- Stamina drain overhaul. Most spells and weapons have their stamina drain values adjusted to make stamina management more important. (especially for the early game).
- Lots of balance changes and bug fixes.

notes.title: Release patch is live!
notes.content:
We are live!

We'd like to thank everyone who participated during early access so far and helped finding bugs and balance issues!

What's new:
- The game now contains all 50 levels with some nasty bosses at the end.
- 9 additional biomes with unique monsters, legendaries and loot.
- Each new biome has it's own unique music track.
- Weapon Ultimates - Non magical characters now have the ability to use powerful weapon ultimates.
- Learn Spells option - If you find that having all spells directly available during level up is too easy, this option is for you.
- Improved resolution support for 16:10 and 4:3 monitors.


We had a bug during early access that resulted in some people having absurd amounts of high scores. Therefore we decided to purge some of the scores at the top.

notes.title: Feature Spotlight: Weapon Ultimates
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tk9sEYEjoRE

In todays feature spotlight video we're looking at a brand new features: Weapon Ultimates. They are available with 100 skill in the appropriate weapon category and no points in any magical categories.

Each weapon type has it's own unique ultimate. But they should be used wisely as they cost twice as much stamina as a normal attack.

notes.title: Patchnotes
notes.content:
Todays update adds custom portraits to the game. Here is how it works:

1. You need a portrait (150x150 pixels) in png or jpg format.
2. Optionally you can also add a custom combat avatar (64x64) pixels in png format.
3. Open your steamapps folder.
4. Goto Equilibrium Of Divinity\Assets\EOD\Images\Portraits
5. Copy your new portrait in that folder and give it a name followed by a "_m" or "_f" depending whether that portrait is male or female.
6. Goto Equilibrium OF Divinity\Assets\EOD\Images\Icons\Characters
7. If you have a custom combat avatar for that portrait, copy it into this folder. If you don't have one copy an existing one that you like.
8. Make sure the combat avatar has the same name as your portrait.

If you run into issues make sure to check by our discussion board here on steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Todays update adds a couple of convenience features as well as some minor bug fixes:

- You can repeat all actions by right clicking the repeat button during combat.
- Camera zooming is now disable during combat.

notes.title: Equilibrium Of Divinity is released into Early Access
notes.content:
We're happy to release Equilibrium Of Divinity into Early Access.

We hope that you all will enjoy the game.

It was an amazing experience, to create and shape this game and it makes us very happy, that we are now able to release to more than just a closed user group.

In the current version, the first 30 levels are available and eventually by 1.0 we will have the full 50 levels in the game as per plan. Of course, if you buy now you will regularly get updates and full access to all levels as soon as they become available.

notes.title: Stronger Legendaries
notes.content: We realized that the legendary creatures in the game were too weak. So we buffed them up in todays update to provide more of a challenge to the players. Additionally each legendary creature will get a unique drop in a future update to give players more incentive to kill them in the first place.
